ActionBar.doc: Accessible name of the toolbar, e.g. "Page actions".

ActionBar.name: end

ActionBar.doc: Always shown at the end and never folds, e.g. the composer's send button.

ActionBar.name: width
ActionBar.doc: `fill` (default) takes the row and pushes `end` to its far edge. `content` is only as wide as the items need, up to the parent's width, so a neighbour that fades (a page title) gives way before the bar does.

AddReactionButton.name: caption

AddReactionButton.name: shrink

AddReactionButton.name: snug

AddReactionButton.name: widthOf

AddReactionButton.name: asChild
AddReactionButton.doc: Styles its one child instead, such as a router Link.

AddReactionButton.name: hint
AddReactionButton.doc: The tooltip's text when it says more than the label: what a check does, or why a toggle can't change here. The label stays the accessible name.

AddReactionButton.name: shortcut
AddReactionButton.doc: The command's shortcut as it reads, such as "⌘N", shown after the label while hints are on.

AddReactionButton.name: tooltipSide
AddReactionButton.doc: Which side of the button the tooltip opens on. Defaults to top, flipping when there's no room.

AddReactionButton.name: count
AddReactionButton.doc: A count over the icon's corner, such as a view's changed files; nothing at zero.

Avatar.name: outline

CallBar.name: label
CallBar.doc: Its accessible name, such as "Call controls".

CallBar.name: children

CallBar.doc: The call's controls as IconButtons: microphone, camera, screen, then the rest, with a `ToolbarDivider`'s space before Leave (`variant="danger"`).

CallCaptions.name: lines
CallCaptions.doc: The last few things said, oldest first; each leaves on its own after a few seconds.

CallControl.name: label
CallControl.doc: What pressing it does now, such as "Mute" or "Turn camera on": its accessible name and tooltip.

CallControl.name: children
CallControl.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstruct…
CallControl.doc: The glyph for its state now: a microphone, or a crossed-out one while muted.

CallControl.name: off
CallControl.doc: The thing is off (muted, camera off). The button fills, white in the dark theme and black in the light one, so being muted reads at a glance from across the room, not only from the glyph.

CallControl.name: menuLabel
CallControl.doc: The device menu's name, such as "Audio devices". Needed with `menu`.

CallControl.name: menu
CallControl.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstruct…
CallControl.doc: The menu its chevron opens, as menu rows (`MenuLabel`, `MenuRadioGroup` of devices, a `MenuCheckItem`): which microphone, speaker or camera the call uses. Without it there is no chevron.

CallControl.name: menuOpen
CallControl.doc: The device menu open or shut, for opening it from elsewhere (a notice's action).

CallLeave.name: label
CallLeave.doc: Its tooltip and accessible name. Defaults to "Leave".

CallLobby.name: preview
CallLobby.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstruct…
CallLobby.doc: Your own picture before you join: a `CallTile` with your camera, or your face.

CallLobby.name: controls
CallLobby.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstruct…
CallLobby.doc: The microphone and camera `CallControl`s, set as they'll be when you join.

CallLobby.name: title
CallLobby.doc: Where you're about to go, such as the voice channel's name.

CallLobby.name: line
CallLobby.doc: Who is there now, in plain words ("Ana and Sam are here").

CallLobby.name: action
CallLobby.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstruct…
CallLobby.doc: The one action, Join, as a primary `Button` at `lg`.

CallReactions.name: reactions
CallReactions.doc: The reactions offered, each with its name for its tooltip and accessible name.

CallReactions.name: onPick
CallReactions.doc: Sends one into the call. The row stays open, so several can go in a row.

CallStage.name: focus
CallStage.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstruct…
CallStage.doc: The tile everyone is looking at (a shared screen, a person picked), drawn large with the rest of the tiles in a strip beside it. Without it every tile shares the stage equally.

CallStage.name: children
CallStage.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstruct…
CallStage.doc: The call's tiles (`CallTile`), one per person.

CallStage.name: dimmed
CallStage.doc: The call has lost its connection and is getting it back: every tile dims until it does. Say so in words beside it (a notice), since dimming alone doesn't tell why.

CallTile.name: name
CallTile.doc: Who it is, at its foot.

CallTile.name: picture
CallTile.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstruct…
CallTile.doc: Their camera or a shared screen, a `video` element, or for an agent the page it is working on now, an `img`: either fills the tile.

CallTile.name: face
CallTile.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstruct…
CallTile.doc: Shown in the middle when there is no picture: their avatar, at `lg`.

CallTile.name: children
CallTile.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstruct…
CallTile.doc: In place of a picture or a face, such as a shared screen waiting to be watched.

CallTile.name: fit
CallTile.doc: How the picture fills the tile: a camera covers it, a screen is shown whole.

CallTile.name: mirror
CallTile.doc: The picture is the person's own camera: shown mirrored, as a mirror shows them and as every call app shows its self-view, while everyone else sees it the right way round. Never for a shared screen or anyone else's camera.

CallTile.name: speaking
CallTile.doc: Talking now: a ring in the done tone, as `VoicePerson` draws it in the sidebar.

CallTile.name: muted
CallTile.doc: Their microphone is off: a crossed-out microphone by the name.

CallTile.name: deafened
CallTile.doc: They hear nothing of the call (an agent away doing what it was asked): crossed-out headphones by the name.

CallTile.name: weak
CallTile.doc: Their connection is poor, so their picture or voice may stutter: a low signal mark and the words at the tile's bottom right, in the waiting tone. Leave it off while the connection is fine.

CallTile.name: hand
CallTile.doc: Their hand is up: a ring in the waiting tone (unless they're talking) and a hand before their name, until they or someone lowers it.

CallTile.name: handPlace
CallTile.doc: Where their raised hand stands in line, 1 being first, shown after the hand while more than one hand is up. Leave it off while theirs is the only one.

CallTile.name: reaction
CallTile.doc: A reaction they just sent, rising off the tile and fading. Give each a new `key` so the same emoji twice plays twice; leave it off once it has played.

CallTile.name: zoom
CallTile.doc: How far the picture is zoomed in, 1 being whole. Above 1 the picture grows inside the tile, which scrolls to move around it: for reading a shared screen.

CallTile.name: actions
CallTile.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstruct…
CallTile.doc: IconButtons at its top right, shown while it is hovered or holds focus.

ChannelWelcome.name: mark

ChannelWelcome.doc: A person's face for a direct message, in place of the icon.

ChannelWelcome.name: line
ChannelWelcome.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstruct…

ChannelWelcome.name: actions
ChannelWelcome.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstruct…
ChannelWelcome.doc: A few secondary or quiet Buttons under the line, at the default size.

ChannelWelcome.name: align
ChannelWelcome.doc: "center" for a direct message or an agent chat: the face, name, line and buttons centered.

ChoiceGroup.name: size
ChoiceGroup.doc: sm 27, md 36 (default). The track is inside that height.

ChoiceGroup.name: fill
ChoiceGroup.doc: Stretch the options to fill the row in equal parts; long labels then fade.

ChoiceGroup.name: track
ChoiceGroup.doc: The track's look: `outline` (default) is a hairline around the sidebar's fill, the options inset in it. `well` is a faint wash with no edge or inset and 2.25px between the options, the chosen option a stronger wash filling its whole height with the track's own corners, and every icon in the text color: the sidebar's Personal/Spaces switch.

ChoiceList.name: label
ChoiceList.doc: What is being chosen, for screen readers: usually the question itself.

ChoiceList.name: selected
ChoiceList.doc: The picked values. One at most unless `multiple`.

ChoiceList.name: onSelect
ChoiceList.doc: Called with the value of the row chosen; the caller toggles or replaces.

ChoiceList.name: multiple
ChoiceList.doc: Several may be picked: the rows are checkboxes.

ChoiceList.name: shortcuts
ChoiceList.doc: Announces 1–9 as each row's shortcut. The caller handles the keys.

ChoiceTile.name: label
ChoiceTile.doc: What the tile picks: its accessible name, and its tooltip when there is no caption.

ChoiceTile.name: children
ChoiceTile.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstruct…
ChoiceTile.doc: The picture: an avatar, an emoji, a color or a preview. It is drawn as given.

ChoiceTile.name: selected
ChoiceTile.doc: The one picked in its set: a filled tile.

ChoiceTile.name: caption
ChoiceTile.doc: A short name under the picture; it fades when the tile is narrow.

ChoiceTile.name: look
ChoiceTile.doc: `outline` draws the tile's edge, for tiles that sit on a bare surface. Default `plain`.

ChoiceTile.name: roomy
ChoiceTile.doc: A taller tile, 13.5px above and below the picture, for a grid of named choices (topics).

ChoiceTile.name: radio
ChoiceTile.doc: A radio in a `radiogroup` instead of a toggle: the picked tile is `aria-checked` rather than `aria-pressed`, with the same fill.

CodeBlock.name: code
CodeBlock.doc: The code, exactly as it should be copied.

CodeBlock.name: wrap
CodeBlock.doc: Long lines wrap onto the next line instead of scrolling sideways. Off by default, since code reads by its lines; turn it on for a command or a path a person should see whole.

CodeBlock.name: language
CodeBlock.doc: Colors the code by what each part is (keywords, strings, calls, properties), in the theme's tones. Leave it out for output and plain text, which stay one color.

CodeBlock.name: header
CodeBlock.doc: A title bar over the code, as a docs page shows a terminal or a file: the label at the start (`true` names the language) and the copy button at the end, always visible. For code a page is about; a command in a sentence stays bare.

CodeBlock.name: copy
CodeBlock.doc: Shows the copy button. On by default.

CodeBlock.name: copyLabel
CodeBlock.doc: The copy button's name and tooltip. Defaults to "Copy".

CodeDiff.name: label
CodeDiff.doc: The table's accessible name, such as "Changes".

CodeText.name: tone
CodeText.doc: One of `Text`'s tones; leave it out to keep the surrounding color.

CollectionControls.name: actions
CollectionControls.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstruct…
CollectionControls.doc: Controls at the far end, after a divider, such as CollectionViewToggle.

CollectionControls.name: filterControl
CollectionControls.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstruct…
CollectionControls.doc: The collection's filter menu, such as `useCollectionRefinement().control`.

CollectionControls.name: utilities
CollectionControls.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstruct…
CollectionControls.doc: More utilities beside the filter menu and column chooser.

CollectionHeading.name: title
CollectionHeading.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstruct…
CollectionHeading.doc: The page's name, or a node that stands for it, such as a Space switcher menu. Left out, the band is only the page's controls at its end, with no hairline (see PageHeader).

CollectionHeading.name: actions
CollectionHeading.doc: The page's actions. They give way like any ActionBar once the title has faded.

CollectionHeading.name: actionsLabel
CollectionHeading.doc: Accessible name of the actions toolbar. Default "Page actions".

CollectionHeading.name: end
CollectionHeading.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstruct…
CollectionHeading.doc: Always shown after the actions and never folds, such as the collection's search field.

CollectionItems.name: fields
CollectionItems.doc: Metadata labels, in display order; also defines columns when there are no rows.

CollectionItems.name: sortResetKey
CollectionItems.doc: Reset a header sort when the owning surface changes its menu ordering or section.

CollectionItems.name: stickyActions
CollectionItems.doc: Keep operational controls visible when a wide table scrolls horizontally.

CollectionItems.name: gridLayout
CollectionItems.doc: Compact cards suit icon-based catalogs; preview cards emphasize artwork; `icons` is a file manager's icon view, each item a large icon over its name with no card (CollectionIconGrid).

CollectionItems.name: listIcons
CollectionItems.doc: List rows start with the item's icon in a framed tile, in its tone, and the title may take two lines. `inline` keeps 36px rows with the icon at the glyph size before the name, as a file manager's list (Files). Off, rows are 36px and start with their text.

CollectionItems.name: cardTitleLines
CollectionItems.doc: How many lines a compact card's title may take before it fades.

CollectionItems.name: zoom
CollectionItems.doc: How big the `icons` grid draws its tiles: 0 small, 1 the default, 2 large.

CollectionItems.name: onSelect
CollectionItems.type: (event: MouseEvent<Element, MouseEvent>, id: string, onOpen: () => void) => void

CollectionItems.name: remember
CollectionItems.doc: Keeps the header sort, the hidden columns and the widths the columns were dragged to in `misty.db` under this key; without it they last for the page.

CollectionItems.name: drag
CollectionItems.doc: Moves items by dragging them with the pointer (never the native drag loop). The picked items go together when one of them is dragged, and they dim while they move. Items with `dropTarget` and the background take the drop: `onDrop(target, ids, copy)`, with `target` null for the background and `copy` true while ⌥ is held. `canDrop` refuses a folder.

CollectionItems.name: sort
CollectionItems.doc: The order, held by the caller instead of here, for a page that also sorts from a menu (Kura's ⋯ › Sort): the header sorts through `onSortChange` too. Null keeps the items' own order.

CollectionItems.name: onSortChange
CollectionItems.type: (sort: { key: string; descending: boolean; } | null) => void

CollectionItems.name: ordered
CollectionItems.doc: The items arrive already in the order to draw them, sorted by the caller: a header click still reports the order through `onSortChange` and marks its column, but nothing is sorted here.

CollectionItems.name: onShownOrder
CollectionItems.doc: Told the ids in the order they are drawn and how many sit in a row (1 for the list), each time either changes, so arrow keys can move through what the person sees.

CollectionItems.name: reveal
CollectionItems.doc: Scrolls the item with this id into view each time it changes to a new id, such as the one the arrow keys just moved to: items out of view aren't drawn.

CollectionSearch.name: containerClassName
CollectionSearch.doc: Layout only (width, flex, margins) for the field's frame; `className` goes to the text box inside it. Its height and corners are the shared field frame's and never change.

CollectionSearch.name: onClear
CollectionSearch.doc: Clears the search. Without it, clearing empties the box through its own `onChange`.

CollectionSearch.name: framed
CollectionSearch.doc: A field's frame instead of the fill: a hairline around the card's color, as Kura's search beside its path bar (PathField `framed`). The edge turns strong under the pointer and while typing.

CollectionSkeleton.name: view
CollectionSkeleton.doc: `list` is the table with its header; `rows` the same rows without one; `grid` the cards.

CollectionSkeleton.name: icons
CollectionSkeleton.doc: The table's rows start with an icon (`listIcons`): 54px rows with a 36px icon box.

CollectionSkeleton.name: cards
CollectionSkeleton.doc: The grid's card layout: `preview` cards with a picture, or `compact` icon-and-title cards.

CollectionViewToggle.name: columns
CollectionViewToggle.doc: Column view (ColumnBrowser), kept by the caller beside its grid or list choice: `active` while it shows, `onSelect` to switch to it. Picking grid or list calls `onChange` as before.

ColorSwatch.name: color

SidewaysScroll.name: onOverflowChange

Skeleton.name: as

SkeletonList.name: trailing

StateMark.name: label

StepDot.name: size

StepPage.name: nav

StepPage.name: label

StepPage.name: onBack
StepPage.doc: Goes to the step before; Back shows only when it is given.

StepPage.name: title
StepPage.doc: The step's heading. It rises into place again each time it changes.

StepPage.name: children
StepPage.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstruct…
StepPage.doc: The step's content, under its heading.

StepPage.name: actions

StepProgress.name: current

StepProgress.name: label

SuggestionItem.name: icon
SuggestionItem.doc: The 18px icon (or an avatar) the row starts with.

SuggestionItem.name: label
SuggestionItem.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstruct…
SuggestionItem.doc: The row's text, which fades at its end when the list is narrow.

SuggestionItem.name: detail
SuggestionItem.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstruct…
SuggestionItem.doc: Muted text after the label, such as a kind, a role or a description. It takes at most half the row and fades at its end.

Surface.name: as
Surface.doc: The element to render; a `div` unless it is a list item, a section or the like.

Surface.name: wash
Surface.doc: The shared hover look (Pressable's washes) for a surface that reacts to the pointer but isn't a button itself, such as a row that holds a checkbox and a drag handle. A surface that is clicked as a whole is a Pressable instead.

Surface.name: hovered
Surface.doc: Shows the wash as if hovered, for a hover the page can't see (a native window control the system owns while the pointer is over it).

Surface.name: flash
Surface.doc: Briefly marks the surface the person was just taken to (a setting found by search).

Surface.name: raised
Surface.doc: Casts a soft shadow under it, for a small card floating over the content of its own pane (a find card over a document) rather than sitting in the page.

Surface.name: floating
Surface.doc: Casts a deep shadow all round, for a panel that slides out over the page from the window's edge (the sidebar revealed while it is collapsed).

Surface.name: state
Surface.doc: The state of the work a card stands for, in the theme's state tones: `working` takes a light wash of the working tone in place of its fill, `waiting` (on the person) an amber edge. Leave it out for work at rest. `waiting` needs an edge to color.

Surface.name: tint
Surface.doc: The kind of made thing the surface stands for (an audio overview, a mind map, a report…), in that kind's color (theme.css --tint-*): its fill and edge mix a little of the color over the page, in place of `tone` and `edge`. `faint` for a tile or a node, `strong` for the one at the center (a mind map's root). With `wash="tint"` the fill deepens under the pointer.

Surface.name: tintLevel
Surface.doc: How much of the tint the fill takes: `faint` (the default) or `strong`.

Surface.name: place
Surface.doc: The color of the place the surface belongs to (a Space's own color, the one its picture tile wears), washed faintly into the sidebar's fill so each Space's sidebar reads as its own room. Only for `tone="sidebar"`; rows, selections and text on it stay neutral.

Surface.name: art
Surface.doc: A solid fill from the full-color art palette in place of `tone`, for a dot or a mark drawn over art (the Studio's room).

Surface.name: artRing
Surface.doc: A 2px ring in an art color around the surface, for a state marked round a picture.

Surface.name: artWash
Surface.doc: A faint wash of an art color with an edge of it, in place of `tone` and `edge`, for something in full color that asks for a look (a question in the Studio).

Surface.name: dimmed
Surface.doc: Set back, for the panes of a split that aren't the one in use (Kura's split panes): faded, coming most of the way back under the pointer. The pane in use stays as it is.

TabStrip.name: label
TabStrip.doc: The tab list's accessible name, e.g. "Open files".

TabStrip.name: onClose
TabStrip.doc: Closes a tab, from its closer or a middle click. Only tabs with a `closeLabel` close.

TabStrip.name: onReorder
TabStrip.type: (id: string, index: number, group?: string | null | undefined) => void
TabStrip.doc: Moves a dragged tab to `index`; without it tabs don't drag. With `groups`, `group` is the group the tab lands in: one it was let go inside of, or null when it was let go outside any.

TabStrip.name: after
TabStrip.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstruct…
TabStrip.doc: A control right after the last tab that scrolls with them, such as a New tab button.

TabStrip.name: end
TabStrip.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstruct…
TabStrip.doc: Controls at the row's far end that never scroll away.

TabStrip.name: windowEdge
TabStrip.doc: The window's own tab row ends 13.5px in, like the sidebar's rows at the window's other side, so the window has one margin on both edges and the end button lines up with the chat's panel rail under it. A page's tab row keeps the page header's 18px.

TabStrip.name: dragCarries
TabStrip.doc: What a dragged tab is to drop targets beyond the row, by scope (the window's tab carries its page's view to the panes as `workspace-tabs`), so it can be dropped into a split.

TabStrip.name: onDragDwell
TabStrip.doc: A drag paused over a tab for a moment, while still held: the window opens that tab, so the dragged page can be dropped into its panes. A tab makes room only once the dragged tab's pointer has crossed all of it, so it stays under the pointer while the drag rests on it, washed while it is the one the drag is over. Drags from outside the row (a sidebar chat) that carry `workspace-tab-switch` pause the same way.

TabStrip.name: groups
TabStrip.doc: Groups of tabs, as Chrome draws them: a chip in the group's color before its tabs (its name, or a dot when unnamed), a line of that color under them, and a thin ring of it around the open tab. Pressing a chip folds its tabs away or brings them back (`onToggleGroup`), sliding them shut or open; a new tab slides in; a right-click opens the group's `menu`.

TabStrip.name: onToggleGroup
TabStrip.doc: Folds or unfolds a group: from its chip, or when a dragged tab pauses over a folded chip.

TabStrip.name: onDropOnTab
TabStrip.doc: A dragged tab let go on another tab: in Chrome's way, the two go into one group.

TabStrip.name: onDropOnGroup
TabStrip.doc: A dragged tab let go on a group's chip: it joins that group.

TabStrip.name: onMoveGroup
TabStrip.doc: A group dragged by its chip and let go: its tabs move, together, to just before `before`, or to the end when it is null. Without it groups don't drag.

Text.name: wrap
Text.doc: A paragraph instead of a label: the text wraps onto as many lines as it needs at the role's own line height, with no fade and no line limit, and a long word breaks rather than spilling past the edge. For descriptions and explanations. `full` and `lines` don't apply. Defaults the element to `p`.

Text.name: bare
Text.doc: The role's size, tone and weight on an element that keeps its own layout: a container whose children take its color (a row of an icon and words, a list), or a run of text inside other text. No fade, no wrapping rules, no display change. Defaults the element to `span`.

Text.name: tint
Text.doc: The color of a kind of made thing (Surface's `tint`, theme.css --tint-*) in place of `tone`, for the glyph that says what an item is: a studio tile's icon, a made report's.

Text.name: art
Text.doc: A color from the full-color art palette in place of `tone`, for text drawn on or over art (the Studio's room, a whiteboard in it). It stays the same in either theme.

Text.name: as
Text.doc: The element to render. Defaults to `span`, laid out as a block so it can clip.

Text.name: dateTime
Text.doc: With `as="time"`: the machine-readable moment it shows.

Text.name: full
Text.doc: Shows the whole text in a tooltip, only while it doesn't fit. `true` uses the label's own text; a string is shown instead, for a label whose children aren't plain text.

Text.name: fullSide
Text.doc: Which side of the label that tooltip opens on. Defaults to top, flipping when there's no room; a label in a bar along the window's top, such as a tab, opens beside it so the tooltip never drops over a native page under the bar.

Text.name: lines
Text.doc: How many lines the text may take before its last line fades. Text over more than one line wraps between words; a caller's `whitespace-pre-wrap` keeps its own line breaks.

Text.name: children
Text.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstruct…

Textarea.name: variant
Textarea.doc: default for prose, code for config and command editors, composer inside a composer.

ToolSuspense.name: size
ToolSuspense.doc: `pane` fills and centers in the tool's own space (an editor, a terminal, a canvas); `inline` sits in the flow of a section or a dialog; `row` is one line at a control's height, for a setting row whose value comes from a native check.

ToolSuspense.name: label
ToolSuspense.doc: The line in place of "Setting up the …", for a setup that is better named by what it does: "Joining the drawing", "Checking Claude Code", "Connecting to the database".

ToolSuspense.name: tool
ToolSuspense.doc: What is getting ready, as it reads after "Setting up the": "video editor", "terminal".

ToolSuspense.name: named
ToolSuspense.doc: `tool` is a name of its own, such as an app's ("CyberChef"), so it reads without "the": "Setting up CyberChef", "CyberChef couldn't start".

ToolSuspense.name: stallAfterMs
ToolSuspense.doc: After this long still setting up, it says so and offers Try again, so a setup that never finishes never leaves the person waiting on a line forever. `false` for a setup that may rightly take long (a download with its own progress). Default 20 seconds.

ToolSuspense.name: frame
ToolSuspense.doc: What the setup line sits in while the tool isn't there, for a tool that keeps a set room (a sketch's board, a preview's card): it wraps the setting-up and failed states, not the tool.

Tooltip.name: content

Tooltip.name: shortcut
Tooltip.doc: The command's shortcut as it reads, such as "⌘N". Shown only while shortcut hints are on.

Tooltip.name: side
Tooltip.doc: Defaults to top; it flips when there's no room.

Tooltip.name: children

TooltipProvider.name: delayDuration

TooltipProvider.name: skipDelayDuration

TooltipProvider.name: shortcutHints
